title: Preset clears stale analysis
steps: Run any preset and wait for a result.
Click a different preset without analyzing it.

title: New analysis resets consultant result
steps: Verify R512345 and wait for the result.
expected: The consultant query and result are cleared.

title: Edited text is not paired with stale output
steps: Edit the textarea after the result appears.
expected: The interface must not imply the old result analyzes the new text. Record the current behaviour; clearing on edit is preferred.

title: Failed request does not preserve old result
steps: Stop the backend or use an invalid API URL.
expected: An error is shown and the previous result does not remain visible as if current.

title: Repeated clicks do not overlap requests
expected: The button disables while loading and only one visible result is produced.

title: Loading and error states
steps: Run an analysis after a backend cold start.
expected: A loading state appears; the failure message is understandable and the interface recovers.

title: Legitimate result is calm
expected: Low-risk presentation is reassuring, contains no manufactured red flags, and does not use alarmist language.

title: Fuzzy consultant match is qualified
expected: A possible/closest match is shown with an explicit fuzzy-match warning; it is not presented as an exact verification.

title: Mobile layout
steps: Run a scam and a legitimate scenario.
expected: No horizontal overflow, clipped controls, unreadable text, or broken result cards.

title: Long valid input layout
steps: Paste a message of roughly 7,000–9,000 characters.
expected: The request is accepted, the layout remains usable, and long content does not overflow result cards.
